messages:
Maya R.: BillingBot flagged a returned ACH for invoice #4478 (Aurelia Systems) — return code R07 (authorization revoked). Bank provided note: "Customer revoked authorization via their bank on 2026-03-04." Amount $32,412.30.
BillingBot: Automated: payment_failed - invoice:4478 - amount:$32412.30 - method:ACH - return_code:R07 - timestamp:168#REDACTED. See docs: https://bank-docs.example.com/ach-codes#R07
Priya S.: ugh, R07s usually mean customer told bank to stop. have we attempted outreach to the customer yet?
Maya R.: Not yet — flagged this morning. I left a voicemail with billing@aureliasys.com and sent the standard dunning email.
Jared K.: Can we check whether they had a signed ACH authorization on file? if not, we should pause collections and follow legal.
Maya R.: We do have a signed authorization (doc id: AUTH-2024-112). Copy attached in the portal.
Ethan L.: Quick ask: can we offer a 14-day extension and reattempt ACH one time? or do we want to push an invoice hold + notify sales for account escalation?
Priya S.: Given amount, suggest reattempt once, email + call now, and place a temporary billing hold so we don't auto-escalate to collections until we hear back. also propose small late fee waiver to encourage payment — say waive the $250 late fee if they pay within 7 days.
Maya R.: Proposed outbound steps: 1) reattempt ACH on next settlement (tomorrow), 2) call finance lead & AE today, 3) send formal notice with 7-day payment window & late fee waiver offer, 4) if no response, escalate to Collections in 7 days. ok?
Jared K.: fine with that. what's the risk of chargeback liability if we reattempt? any extra exposure?
Maya R.: bank says re-present is allowed for R07 but customer bank may still block and escalate. Legal flagged that multiple reattempts without explicit customer contact could be risky. one reattempt OK since we have signed auth + we will cc AE contact on the outreach.
CollectionsBot: Note: Customer Aurelia Systems (acct A-9912) has outstanding invoice 4478. Current policy: 1 reattempt on return_code R07 if signed authorization exists. If unpaid after 7 days, escalate to collections queue C2.
Ethan L.: Approving Maya's plan. go ahead with one reattempt and outreach. keep AE and sales ops in loop. Priya — please draft the waiver notice and copy legal on wording.
Priya S.: Will draft now and drop in #finance-docs for signoff. suggested subject: "Payment attempt failed — one-time reattempt & fee waiver offer". Will include exact language for authorization reference and dispute instructions.
Maya R.: I'll schedule the ACH reattempt for tomorrow 09:00 PT and call the AE (Liam) in 30m. tagging @Ethan L. for visibility.
Ethan L.: thanks. if they push back claiming they revoked auth, we escalate to legal + hold further attempts.
Priya S.: Draft done, pasted below for quick review:

"Dear Aurelia Systems — We attempted to collect payment for invoice #4478 ($32,412.30) via ACH on 2026-03-04 but it was returned (R07: authorization revoked). We have a signed ACH authorization on file (AUTH-2024-112). As a one-time courtesy we will reattempt the ACH once on 2026-03-05. If payment is completed within 7 days we will waive the $250 late fee. If you dispute the authorization, please reply within 5 business days with the dispute details and supporting documentation. If we do not hear from you, this invoice will be routed to Collections on 2026-03-12.

Sincerely,
Redwood Billing Team"

Maya R.: looks good. drop legal on copy per Jared's note.
Jared K.: copying legal now (legal@redwood.com). also add a quick note to the CRM: set dunning status = reattempt-scheduled.
BillingBot: Action logged: reattempt_scheduled - invoice:4478 - attempt_time:2026-03-05T16:00:00Z - triggered_by:Maya R.
Priya S.: thanks all. I'll post the final email thread after legal ack.
Ethan L.: good work. if Aurelia asks for a payment plan instead of ACH, we can offer a 30/30 split but require e-signature. Priya, coordinate with sales ops on that if needed. :thumbsup:
Maya R.: will update thread after call.
CollectionsBot: Reminder scheduled: escalate invoice 4478 to collections queue on 2026-03-12 if status != PAID or ARRANGED.
Maya R.: call complete — AE confirmed they haven't heard from finance, AE will try procurement contact now. awaiting customer's response.
Priya S.: uploaded final email (with legal cc) to thread and to billing portal. leaving note: waive_fee_if_paid_in_7_days=true
Ethan L.: keep this open; mark resolved only after payment or collections escalation.
Maya R.: updating CRM now. will follow up end of day tomorrow if no response. :spiral_calendar:
